sections.title: In short
paragraphs: Questling has no accounts and sends your data to no one: everything stays on your device.
There is no advertising, tracking, analytics or profiling.
You can export or delete your data at any time from Settings.

sections.title: Data on your device
paragraphs: The app stores on your device the name you choose, your hero, your quiz answers, the quests you write, your completions, your experience and your settings (language, reminder times, sounds, vibration).
This data never leaves your device. Notifications are scheduled by your phone's system: they do not go through any server.
You can export it to a backup file (Settings, Export backup) or delete it (Settings, Delete all local data).

sections.title: Third-party services
paragraphs: Questling uses no third-party services for analytics, advertising or sign-in. Fonts and images are included in the app and no connection is needed to use it.
If you use Export backup, you save or share the file yourself with the app you choose: from then on, how it is handled depends on that app.

sections.title: Retention and deletion
paragraphs: Your data stays on your device until you delete it (Settings, Delete all local data) or uninstall the app. We hold no copies.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: Since we hold no copy of your data, you can access, correct, port and delete it yourself in the app (rename, Export backup, Delete all local data).
For any request write to the contact above. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with your data protection authority (in Italy, the Garante: garanteprivacy.it).

sections.title: Children
paragraphs: The app is not aimed at children. If you are under 14, use it with the consent of a parent or guardian.

sections.title: Security
paragraphs: Data saved on your device is not encrypted by the app: your phone's lock protects it. We recommend keeping your screen lock on.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: If we change how we handle data we will update this page and the date above. In particular, if a future version adds an optional account to sync your data, we will update this policy and tell you in the app before collecting any data.
